ownerDirection.purposeAndMission: Create a professional, industry-level music production studio accessible from LAMBOCITYRECORDS.com on an iPad or other supported device, allowing artists and producers anywhere to record, edit, mix, master, and complete release-quality songs. The Studio is the digital headquarters of LAMBO CITY Records and should give artists the tools, confidence, and experience of recording in an exclusive major-label studio. It should help artists hear their work with a polished, professional sound and feel valued, supported, and like stars.
qualityAmbition: Aim for professional, release-ready recording, mixing, and mastering capability.
Provide a complete artist and producer workflow, not a generic beat-making toy.
Offer curated, high-quality sound collections and useful production starting points.
Provide professional vocal tools including pitch correction, reverb, delay, and additional effects.
Support the creative character, musicality, and soul associated with great records.
experienceVision: Open LAMBOCITYRECORDS.com on an iPad or supported device.
Tap Studio and enter the LAMBO CITY Records production environment.
Record and produce music with professional tools in one accessible workspace.
Hear polished mixes and masters and have a path to complete songs.
Feel like a valued artist recording at the LAMBO CITY Records headquarters.

designProtection.editInterface: PROTECTED. The current EDIT interface design, layout, and visual identity are approved by the owner and must not be redesigned or replaced.
allowedImprovements: Improve functionality, precision, controls, responsiveness, feedback, accessibility, and reliability.
Add restrained luxury details and realistic studio equipment detail without changing the approved EDIT design or disrupting its workflow.
Improve the underlying systems while preserving familiar placement and behavior.
designProtection.otherInterfaces: Piano, drums/MPC, and MIX & MASTER need their own dedicated interfaces and may be developed further because their designs are not yet considered final.

systemDirection.edit: Preserve current design; improve the production and editing capabilities underneath it.
systemDirection.mixAndMaster: Build a dedicated professional mixing and mastering interface.
systemDirection.piano: Develop a dedicated, improved piano and instrument interface.
systemDirection.drumsAndMPC: Develop dedicated drum and MPC interfaces with clear, complementary purposes.
systemDirection.recordingAndVocals: Provide an end-to-end vocal and recording workflow with professional effects and monitoring.
systemDirection.soundLibrary: Create curated, detailed, original sound banks with high-quality production character and accessible starting points.

labelAndCommunityVision.role: The Studio is the digital headquarters and artist-development environment for LAMBO CITY Records.
longTermCommunity: Artists and producers from different places can participate in the LAMBO CITY Records ecosystem.
Artists can have their own name, profile, in-world character, skins, and outfits.
The environment should help artists feel welcomed, supported, and presented like stars.
Future opportunities may include LAMBO CITY Radio and other label-related pathways.
labelAndCommunityVision.royaltyAndRightsVision: The owner envisions future pathways for eligible artists and works to participate in music-rights and royalty systems, potentially involving PROs such as ASCAP or BMI. This requires separate rights, ownership, metadata, registration, distribution, and legal workflows; Studio access or a recording alone must never be represented as a guarantee of royalties or chart success.
labelAndCommunityVision.phaseStatus: Long-term product vision. Online collaboration, accounts, persistent artist profiles, and community features require a separate phase decision because existing project direction keeps the initial world single-player and defers accounts/backend/multiplayer.

creativeReferences.rule: Use these as broad creative and production-quality references only. Do not imitate protected recordings, copy proprietary presets, or use unlicensed samples. Develop an original LAMBO CITY sound identity.

workspaceArchitecture.name: Central Studio headquarters with dedicated connected workspaces
workspaceArchitecture.entryExperience: Artists enter one central LAMBO CITY Records Studio headquarters, where they can see and continue their current projects.
workspaceArchitecture.sharedSessionRule: All workspaces connect to the same song, project, recordings, transport, and shared production core. Switching workspaces must not create a separate song or lose session state.
designRules: Preserve the approved EDIT interface design and layout.
Develop dedicated interfaces for workspaces whose designs are not final.
Make navigation between workspaces clear and keep the artist oriented within the same Studio project.
workspaceArchitecture.ownerApproval: The owner explicitly selected Option 3 on 2026-11-04.

labelCollaborationModel.name: Real-time collaboration plus asynchronous project sharing
labelCollaborationModel.realTimeCollaboration: Artists can invite other authorized artists or producers into the same Studio project and work together in real time.
labelCollaborationModel.asynchronousCollaboration: Artists can share projects with collaborators who can contribute at different times, with changes saved and tracked safely.
labelCollaborationModel.artistIdentity: The long-term experience includes individual artist identities and profiles, with in-world characters and customizable appearance.
labelCollaborationModel.phaseStatus: Approved long-term product direction. Collaboration is private and invitation-only, controlled by the owner. Do not silently introduce accounts, backend, persistent profiles, shared cloud projects, or multiplayer into the current single-player foundation. Plan and approve those as a distinct architecture and delivery phase.
requiredFutureCapabilities: Secure project sharing and persistent storage
Conflict handling, version history, and recovery
Audio recording and playback synchronization for live collaboration
labelCollaborationModel.ownerApproval: The owner explicitly selected Option C: both real-time collaboration and asynchronous project sharing, on 2026-11-04.

accessPolicy.rule: Real-time co-production and asynchronous project sharing are available only to people the LAMBO CITY Records owner personally selects and invites. Do not make collaboration access public or automatically available to every Studio user.
accessPolicy.permissions: The owner must be able to decide who is invited, which projects they can access, and whether they may view, contribute, record, edit, or manage project content. Define detailed roles and revocation controls in the future collaboration architecture.
accessPolicy.distinction: This restriction applies to the collaborative co-production feature. It does not by itself mean the general Studio or every future artist profile must be invite-only.
accessPolicy.ownerApproval: The owner clarified on 2026-11-04 that collaboration is an exclusive feature for people they personally choose to collaborate with.

openDecisions: Define the owner-controlled invitation workflow, collaborator roles, project-level permissions, and access revocation for private collaboration.
Define the central Studio entrance and the artist journey from opening Studio through creating, recording, editing, mixing, mastering, and exporting a song.
Define the professional acceptance standard for recording, mixing, mastering, latency, and exports.
Define which features are essential for the first complete Studio release versus later expansion.
protectionRules: Do not redesign the approved EDIT interface.
Do not replace working audio engines or create duplicate project/transport systems.
Inspect current modules before making changes.
Develop piano, drums/MPC, and MIX & MASTER as dedicated interfaces connected to shared production services.
Do not promise chart placement, commercial success, or royalty eligibility.
Require owner approval before changing the Studio's approved visual direction or expanding into accounts, backend, or multiplayer.

approval.note: Captures the owner's first three Studio direction answers. This is not yet a complete or approved Studio specification.
